requirement_evidence.evidence: Extract rejects invalid UTF-8 text. validKey rejects empty, invalid UTF-8, whitespace, controls, @, backslash and backtick. Matching uses literal string prefixes without normalization. Registered keys are copied into a fresh slice; caller keys are never modified.

mentionStart decodes the preceding rune and rejects the specified left-boundary characters. identifierRune checks Unicode letters, numbers and marks plus underscore and hyphen. Each candidate receives a decoded right-boundary check; the longest eligible prefix wins, then scanning advances beyond it.

registered removes duplicate keys. Lines and positions are scanned in source order; seen suppresses repeated results without affecting mention selection or advancement. Results append only at the first eligible occurrence, independently of registration order. No matches return nil.

extractLine counts maximal backtick runs. A run opens a span when spanWidth is zero; only an equal-width run closes it. Mentions are suppressed while inside the span. spanWidth is local to each line, so unmatched spans stop hiding content at the newline.

fenceRun accepts only backticks or tildes following zero to three ASCII spaces. Extract ignores opening lines and fenced content. Closing requires the same marker, sufficient width and exclusively space/tab trailing content. LF splitting and trailing CR removal handle CRLF; an unclosed fence suppresses all remaining content.

Extract skips lines whose first character after ASCII spaces/tabs is > before processing fence state. mentionStart counts consecutive preceding backslashes and rejects odd parity before checking the ordinary boundary. Email prefixes fail that boundary. Ordinary quote marks receive no special processing.

Route maps Human Pending to start, Busy to soon and Finished to new. It calls Extract and appends exactly one Delivery for each returned key in the same order. An empty extraction produces no deliveries or implicit target.

Route permits Agent only when state equals Busy, assigning soon. Other agent states and unknown authors or human states return nil. Every delivery comes directly from Extract. Extract has no routing dependency, and all mutable slices, maps and parser state are local to each call.
